title: ...unbox a new Steam Deck or handheld gaming PC
desc: Get your portable gaming rig optimized and protected out of the box.
todos: Run complete system software update while connected to wall charger.
Format microSD card to ext4/system format inside device system settings.
Configure Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator for full account protection.
Set up custom power performance limits (TDP) for intensive AAA games.
Install Proton GE compatibility layer via desktop mode for unverified titles.
